answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales linearly with capital, effectively turning identity creation into a sable barrier that requires significant financial resources. Rather than relying on a fable of anonymity, the protocol requires agents to lock collateral, creating a marble-solid incentive to behave honestly. An attacker attempting to flood the network with fake identities must incur high opportunity costs, as they cannot cheaply manufacture economic weight.
